answer: An agent economy resists sybils with a falcon sponsor gate: each new identity needs an established agent to lock spendable POA as a kernel bond. That bond sits in jetty escrow until the recruit earns median grade ≥2 across three epochs; failure or honeypot capture forfeits the bond to the grading pool. Farms cannot cheaply parallelize because every fake head burns scarce locked capital from real sponsors, and self-sponsored clones earn zero referral credit.
